name: Megadeth

whyMatters.en: Dave Mustaine’s thrash project after Metallica; Rust in Peace (1990) set technical riff density and precision leads as thrash’s upper bound.
whyMatters.zh: Dave Mustaine 离开 Metallica 后的 thrash 计划；Rust in Peace（1990）把技术 riff 密度与精密主音定为 thrash 上界。

note.en: Rust in Peace opener; tempo shifts + Friedman leads.
note.zh: Rust in Peace 开场；速度切换 + Friedman 主音。

note.en: Conspiracy lyric over escalating solo duel.
note.zh: 阴谋论歌词上的升级独奏对决。

note.en: Bass intro + Mustaine snarl; MTV news bumper fame.
note.zh: 贝斯前奏 + Mustaine 咆哮；MTV 新闻片头成名。

interviewQuotes.text: I was kicked out of Metallica for drinking too much and being an asshole.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Dave Mustaine

lyricQuotes: What do you mean I don't believe in God? / I talk to him every day

shortBio.en: Mustaine thrash after Metallica firing; Rust in Peace is the technical peak.
shortBio.zh: Mustaine 被 Metallica 开除后的 thrash；Rust in Peace 是技术峰值。

body.en:
Formed 1983 after Mustaine’s Metallica exit. Peace Sells builds US thrash profile. Rust in Peace (1990) with Friedman/Menza locks precision thrash. Countdown to Extinction adds radio cuts.

Lineup churn is constant; Mustaine + riff density is the brand. Rivalry with Metallica stays the origin myth.
body.zh:
Mustaine 离开 Metallica 后于 1983 组建。Peace Sells 建立美国 thrash 轮廓。与 Friedman/Menza 的 Rust in Peace（1990）锁死精密 thrash。Countdown to Extinction 加入电台曲。

阵容动荡是常量；Mustaine + riff 密度即品牌。与 Metallica 的对峙仍是起源神话。

title.zh: Thrash 对峙作为第二学派

body.en:
Mustaine leaves Metallica 1983 and builds a faster, more chromatic riff school. Peace Sells is the street face; Rust in Peace is the conservatory exam.

Big Four seat earned by density, not just origin lore.
body.zh:
Mustaine 1983 离开 Metallica，建更快、更半音化的 riff 学派。Peace Sells 是街头脸；Rust in Peace 是学院考试。

四大席位靠密度赢得，不只靠起源传说。

title.en: Rust in Peace four as peak
title.zh: Rust in Peace 四人即巅峰

body.en:
Peak: Mustaine / Friedman / Ellefson / Menza (1990–94 approx). Earlier Poland era is rawer. Later casts rotate guitar/drums heavily.

Chronicle peak flag on Rust lineup—technical thrash standard.
body.zh:
巅峰：Mustaine / Friedman / Ellefson / Menza（约 1990–94）。更早 Poland 时期更糙。后来吉他/鼓大量轮换。

编年史巅峰旗在 Rust 阵容——技术 thrash 标准。

title.en: Mustaine bark, Friedman leads, Ellefson bass
title.zh: Mustaine 吠叫、Friedman 主音、Ellefson 贝斯

body.en:
Mustaine: Jackson/Flying V thrash riffs, snarl vocal. Friedman: neo-classical/exotic leads. Ellefson: precise alternate-picked bass. Menza: double-bass clarity.

When Friedman/Menza exit, density drops even if logo stays.
body.zh:
Mustaine：Jackson/Flying V thrash riff、咆哮人声。Friedman：新古典/异域主音。Ellefson：精密交替拨贝斯。Menza：双底鼓清晰。

Friedman/Menza 离开后，即使 logo 在，密度也降。

body.en:
Rust opener. Fast A section, mid grind, solo duel. Politics in the lyric without power-ballad exit.

Thrash composition textbook track.
body.zh:
Rust 开场。快速 A 段、中速碾压、独奏对决。歌词有政治，无强力谣曲出走。

Thrash 作曲教科书曲目。

body.en:
Conspiracy narrative over escalating leads. MTV plays the video; guitarists learn the trade-offs.

Technical thrash that still charts.
body.zh:
阴谋叙事盖在升级主音上。MTV 播影像；吉他手学对位交替。

仍能上榜的技术 thrash。

title.zh: 对着 Metallica 的四大边

body.en:
Origin myth (firing) keeps the Metallica link visible. Rust in Peace remains the precision citation beside Slayer aggression and Metallica groove.

Hub person: Mustaine. No Hetfield person file yet—band-level edge only.
body.zh:
起源神话（开除）让 Metallica 链接可见。Rust in Peace 仍是精密引用，坐在旁边的是 Slayer 攻击与 Metallica 律动。

枢纽人物：Mustaine。尚无 Hetfield person——仅乐队级边。

note.zh: 技术 thrash 巅峰目录。
更早的生猛 thrash 脸。

note.en: Technical thrash opener that set Rust-era standard.
note.zh: 定下 Rust 时期标准的技术 thrash 开场。

note.en: Post-Metallica thrash rival; precision as brand.
note.zh: Metallica 后的 thrash 对峙者；精密即品牌。
